### Free Offer
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/free-offer
Passage: Romans 3:10-18
Points:
- Salvation is offered as a free gift received through faith in Jesus Christ rather than good deeds or church rituals.
- Human pride and suspicion often make people skeptical of receiving something of infinite value without cost.
- Scripture reveals the universal depravity of mankind: no one is righteous, innocent, or seeking after God.
- Sin creates an insurmountable barrier between humans and God, leaving fallen humanity unable to find its own way back.
- While entirely free to us, salvation required Christ paying the ultimate price as our substitute on the cross.

### The Works of the Law
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/works-law
Passage: Romans 3:19-20
Points:
- Sinners instinctively overestimate their goodness and attempt to build a record of righteous works to appease God.
- God's law strips away every excuse and renders the entire world silent and accountable before Him.
- If even God's covenant people could not be justified by keeping the Mosaic law, no human can be saved by law-keeping.
- The law cannot impart life or justification because humanity's thorough corruption distorts what is good.
- The divine law's primary function is not to justify us, but to expose and convict us of our sin.
